entries.test: Public engineering reports, code audits, and incident investigations could establish whether increased pressure and staff cuts lead engineers to adopt AI-generated code that introduces security vulnerabilities and bugs.
entries.note: This is a firm conditional prediction without a deadline. His uncertainty concerns people’s understanding of the consequences, not whether the predicted code problems will occur.
